author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Snøhetta
summary: An architecture practice influential in contemporary form, space and urban thinking in Oslo since 1989. It connects architecture, landscape, interiors, graphics and product design.

hero_image.alt: A workshop table of white and timber massing models with stone samples, dried plants and plan drawings, a person working at the far end.
hero_image.caption: Model, stone and plant on one table: building and landscape decided as a single problem.
